title: Vibrant Paint Splatter
description: An abstract composition of colorful paint splatters and drips on a white surface. Bright yellows, greens, oranges, blues and pinks form organic shapes, bubbles, and flowing vertical drips across the canvas.
prompt: abstract painting featuring vibrant splatters and drips of yellow, lime green, orange, teal, pink and dark green paint on a white canvas. Organic fluid shapes, bubbles, and vertical paint runs create a dynamic energetic composition with high contrast and luminous color blending in the center
